I'm not sure what got over me.  Don't worry about it.

children.p: "You would be wise to control your... little ticks."

"If you seek to learn more about me, then proceed on your path.  I will be watching, and I will contact you if I find you worthy of attention."

He pauses for a moment, as if wondering if he wants to tell you something.  Then he continues.

children.comment: TODO: logistics of weapon stuff (if not weapon equipped should say something like "since you have no weapon then you'll have to strangle him.")

children.p:
Then something odd happens.  The body just... disappears.  It fades away in only a few moments with only the sea breeze disturbing the remains.  All that's left is his purple cloak.  You pick it up.

It doesn't seem like anybody saw your nefarious deed.
With great effort, you prevent yourself from doing something horrible.  You leave this strange man to his oceanic vigil.
"Events are in motion. You will come to find out soon."
"I am Sol.  Seek me in places of great potential change.  Alinea is one such place.  Crater Lake is another."

As you turn to go, the man suddenly reaches out and clasps your shoulder.

"Do not ally yourself too closely with the powers on this Island.  They will soon find out who has the real power here."

choices.text: What do you mean by that?

children.p: You slap away his hand and he drops it limply to his side.  He resumes his vigil as if nothing had happened.
He drops his hand limply to his side, and resumes his vigil as if nothing had happened.

A boot to your back shoves you roughly onto the splintered wood of ship docks.  Before you can stand up, you hear a loud thud as the large leather bag from the rowboat lands beside you.  You stand up and turn around to stare at Captain Argow.  His arms are crossed, and he lets out a deep sigh.

"My duty is done.  Now I can be rid of you."
"I was supposed to tell you something else... I don't remember it exactly.  Something about the number 'nine'.  I don't suppose you know what that is...?"

choices.text: You will regret being so disrespectful to me.
I hope your next journey brings you better luck than the last.

children.p: He ignores your objection.

choices.text: When I speak you WILL not ignore me!

children.p: "I hope so as well."
He kicks off the dock, and the rowboat floats calmly away.  He does not look up at you as he calmly begins to row back to his vessel.
"A little advice: stow your attitude, for your own good."
"Yes.  Thought you might know what that meant, but I guess not."

Looking around, you see that you stand at the tip of a long network of docks, attached to the shore to the north.

You are alone in a new city with only the number "nine" to guide you.

The bag next to you might help you understand more.  Or at least it might have something useful in it.
(To search the bag, examine it with the "Look" action.)

At dawn you are awoken from the deck of the ship with a boot to your chest.  Captain Argow looms above you, alone.  "Get up."

You stand up, and even in the dim light of dawn, you can see land on the horizon.

With the rest of the crew sleeping around you, Captain Argow leads you towards a rowboat at the stern that he has already lowered into the water. You lower yourself inside.  Captain Argow joins you, along with a large leather sack he heaves to the center.

"Row." He says.  You pick up the oars and start taking the both of you towards the land.

Captain Argow guides you towards a settlement on the shoreline.  It looks like a large town of some kind, surrounded by stone walls and towers, backed up against tall cliffs that cast a deep shadow across it in the early morning's light.  This must be Alinea.

When you get close, Argow points towards a smattering of old wooden docks to the west of the town, outside of the walls.  "That'll do.  Dock us to the nearest one."
This is a sealed paper note that Lieutenant Mullen of Alinea trusted you to deliver to the Realm encampment that overlooks the river crossing north of Alinea.
